title: Quests
source: jenil-a9 660-quests-draft (8 Nov), all 66 approved by Jenil ("no keep all the quests")

text.en: Do the task you've been avoiding, for 15 minutes. Stop when the timer ends.
text.hinglish: Jo kaam taal rahe ho, bas 15 minute karo. Timer bajte hi ruk jao.

text.en: Empty your bag. Put back only what you need.
text.hinglish: Bag khaali karo, sirf zaroori cheezein wapas daalo.

text.en: Write one stuck task as a chain of steps, circle the stuck step, and do just that step.
text.hinglish: Atke hue kaam ke steps likho, atka hua step gol karo, bas wahi karo.

text.en: For a small choice you're stuck on, list 3 goods and 3 bads for each side, then pick.
text.hinglish: Ek chhota faisla: dono taraf 3 achhi, 3 buri baatein likho, phir chuno.

text.en: Draw yesterday as 8 blocks. Where did the time go? Mark one block to change.
text.hinglish: Kal ke din ko 8 blocks mein banao. Time kahaan gaya? Ek block badalne ke liye mark karo.

text.en: For 15 minutes, do every 2-minute job you can see: put away, refill, fold, throw out.
text.hinglish: 15 minute tak har 2-minute wala kaam nipta do: rakhna, bharna, tah karna, phenkna.

text.en: Fix one small broken thing at home, properly. Nothing electrical or gas.
text.hinglish: Ghar ki ek chhoti tooti cheez theek se theek karo. Bijli ya gas wali nahi.

text.en: Write 5 things you've already finished today.
text.hinglish: Aaj ke 5 kaam likho jo ho chuke hain.

text.en: Read 10 pages somewhere you've never read before: a bench, a step, a quiet corner.
text.hinglish: 10 page kisi nayi jagah padho: bench, seedhi, koi shaant kona.

text.en: Ask a friend for the best book they've read, and why.
text.hinglish: Kisi dost se poochho: sabse achhi kitaab kaunsi padhi, aur kyun?

text.en: Take one claim you heard today and find a reliable source. Does it hold?
text.hinglish: Aaj suni ek baat lo, bharosemand source dhoondo. Sach nikli ya nahi?

text.en: In a story you're reading or watching, find one moment where a character's actions betray their sweet words.
text.hinglish: Kisi kahaani mein woh pal dhoondo jahaan kirdaar ki meethi baatein uske kaam se jhooth nikli.

text.en: Open 3 books you own but haven't read. Read the first page of each, then pick the next one.
text.hinglish: Apni 3 anpadhi kitaabein kholo, har ek ka pehla page padho, agli chuno.

text.en: On a walk, read every sign, notice and plaque you pass. Find one fact you didn't know.
text.hinglish: Walk pe har board, notice, plaque padho. Ek nayi baat dhoondo.

text.en: Copy one sentence you love from a book into a notebook, by hand.
text.hinglish: Kitaab ki ek pasandida line haath se notebook mein likho.

text.en: Read one full newspaper article on paper, start to end.
text.hinglish: Akhbaar ka ek poora article kaagaz pe, shuru se ant tak padho.

text.en: Teach one idea you kept this week to someone at dinner, in your own words.
text.hinglish: Is hafte ka ek idea khaane pe kisi ko apne shabdon mein samjhao.

text.en: Explain today's lesson to a friend in 1 minute, with no notes.
text.hinglish: Aaj ka lesson dost ko 1 minute mein samjhao, bina notes.

text.en: Show someone a skill of your hands: a knot, a fold, a stitch, a sketch.
text.hinglish: Kisi ko haath ka hunar dikhao: gaanth, fold, silaai, sketch.

text.en: Close the book and write everything you remember from the last chapter on one page. Then check.
text.hinglish: Kitaab band karo, pichhle chapter ka jo yaad hai ek page pe likho. Phir check karo.

text.en: Ask an elder to teach you one thing they're good at, for 15 minutes.
text.hinglish: Ghar ke kisi bade se 15 minute unka ek hunar seekho.

text.en: Use one idea from something you studied, today, in real life.
text.hinglish: Padhi hui ek baat aaj asli zindagi mein use karo.

text.en: With 2 friends, list what each of you can teach and wants to learn. Match one swap.
text.hinglish: 2 doston ke saath likho kaun kya sikha sakta hai, kya seekhna hai. Ek adla-badli tay karo.

text.en: Walk a route you know. At each turn, recall one thing you learned this week.
text.hinglish: Jaana-pehchaana raasta chalo. Har mod pe is hafte ki ek seekhi baat yaad karo.

text.en: Spot 5 red things on your way.
text.hinglish: Raaste mein 5 laal cheezein dhoondo.

text.en: Play a board or card game with someone, in person. No screens.
text.hinglish: Kisi ke saath board ya card game khelo, aamne-saamne. Screen nahi.

text.en: Take apart something old and broken, like a pen or a toy, and work out how it worked. Nothing that plugs in or has a battery.
text.hinglish: Koi purani tooti cheez (pen, khilona) kholo, samjho kaise chalti thi. Plug ya battery wali nahi.

text.en: Make a puzzle on paper for someone (a riddle, a maze or a word chain) and hand it over.
text.hinglish: Kisi ke liye kaagaz pe paheli, maze ya word-chain banao aur de do.

text.en: From a window or balcony, find the moon or 3 stars, and note where they are.
text.hinglish: Khidki ya balcony se chaand ya 3 taare dhoondo, kahaan hain note karo.

text.en: Mark the tip of a shadow, and mark it again an hour later. Which way did it move?
text.hinglish: Ek parchhai ka sira mark karo, ghante baad phir. Kidhar khiski?

text.en: Write 3 questions you'd love answered, then find a talk or book that answers one.
text.hinglish: 3 sawaal likho jinke jawaab chahiye, phir ek ka jawaab kisi talk ya kitaab mein dhoondo.

text.en: Split one shared job (cooking, cleaning) into small roles for the people at home, and do it together.
text.hinglish: Ghar ka ek saajha kaam chhote hisson mein baanto, sab milke karo.

text.en: Get off one stop early and walk the rest.
text.hinglish: Ek stop pehle utro, baaki paidal chalo.

text.en: Stand up and stretch for 5 minutes: neck, shoulders, back, legs.
text.hinglish: Utho, 5 minute stretch: gardan, kandhe, kamar, pair.

text.en: Carry the shopping or the water for someone at home.
text.hinglish: Ghar mein kisi ka saamaan ya paani utha ke le jao.

text.en: Play any game that makes you run, with friends, for 30 minutes.
text.hinglish: Doston ke saath 30 minute koi bhaag-daud wala khel khelo.

text.en: Dance to 3 songs, alone in your room.
text.hinglish: Apne kamre mein akele 3 gaanon pe naacho.

text.en: Learn one new move (a balance, a skip pattern, a stretch) and try it 10 times.
text.hinglish: Ek naya move seekho (balance, skip, stretch), 10 baar try karo.

text.en: Walk to the highest point near you (a hill, a terrace, a bridge) and look out.
text.hinglish: Paas ki sabse oonchi jagah tak chalo (pahaadi, chhat, pul) aur door tak dekho.

text.en: Brush your teeth standing on one foot, then switch sides.
text.hinglish: Ek pair pe khade hoke brush karo, phir pair badlo.

text.en: Spend 5 minutes outside with your phone in your pocket. Notice 3 sounds.
text.hinglish: 5 minute bahar, phone jeb mein. 3 aawaazein suno.

text.en: Make chai, or anything warm, slowly. Do nothing else.
text.hinglish: Chai ya kuch garam, aaram se banao. Aur kuch nahi.

text.en: Sit by a window for 10 minutes and watch the sky change.
text.hinglish: 10 minute khidki ke paas baitho, aasmaan badalta dekho.

text.en: Think of a tense moment from this week. Write the calm reply you wish you'd given.
text.hinglish: Is hafte ka ek tanaav wala pal socho. Woh shaant jawaab likho jo dena chahte the.

text.en: Water the plants slowly, one by one.
text.hinglish: Paudhon ko aaram se, ek-ek karke paani do.

text.en: Lights off, lying down: name 5 good things from today in your head.
text.hinglish: Lights band, lete hue: aaj ki 5 achhi baatein mann mein gino.

text.en: Walk one street at half your usual speed, and look up.
text.hinglish: Ek gali aadhi raftaar se chalo, aur upar dekho.

text.en: Sit with an elder at home for 15 minutes, no phones. Talk, or just be quiet together.
text.hinglish: Ghar ke kisi bade ke saath 15 minute baitho, phone nahi. Baat karo ya bas chup baitho.

text.en: Ask someone at home a question you've never asked them.
text.hinglish: Ghar mein kisi se woh sawaal poochho jo kabhi nahi poocha.

text.en: Ask someone close for honest feedback on one thing you made or did.
text.hinglish: Kisi apne se poochho: maine jo banaya/kiya, sach mein kaisa tha?

text.en: Tell a friend, out loud, one thing you like about them.
text.hinglish: Dost ko munh pe batao, unki ek baat jo tumhe achhi lagti hai.

text.en: Ask one question in class or a meeting.
text.hinglish: Class ya meeting mein ek sawaal poochho.

text.en: Ask a senior one question about their career.
text.hinglish: Kisi senior se unke career ke baare mein ek sawaal poochho.

text.en: Take one question to a teacher's or manager's office hours.
text.hinglish: Ek sawaal leke teacher ya manager ke paas jao.

text.en: Message an old teacher one question about their subject.
text.hinglish: Purane teacher ko unke subject pe ek sawaal message karo.

text.en: Email someone whose work you admire one specific question.
text.hinglish: Jinka kaam pasand hai, unhe ek seedha sawaal email karo.

text.en: Ask someone near you one question about what they're doing or reading.
text.hinglish: Paas waale se poochho: kya padh/kar rahe ho? Ek sawaal.

text.en: Ask for directions to a place, even if you could find it yourself. Daytime.
text.hinglish: Kisi jagah ka raasta poochho, chahe khud dhoondh sakte ho. Din mein.

text.en: Spin a topic and talk about it for 60 seconds, alone.
text.hinglish: Topic ghumao, akele 60 second bolo.

text.en: Say your intro out loud 3 times, with fewer notes each time.
text.hinglish: Apna intro 3 baar bolo, har baar notes kam.

text.en: Spin two topics and link them in 90 seconds.
text.hinglish: Do topic ghumao, 90 second mein jodo.

text.en: Record yourself explaining something you know for 2 minutes. Listen once.
text.hinglish: Jo aata hai, 2 minute record karke samjhao. Ek baar suno.

text.en: Prep for 2 minutes, then pitch one idea in 60 seconds to someone at home.
text.hinglish: 2 minute taiyaari, phir ghar mein kisi ko 60 second mein idea pitch karo.

text.en: Let a friend ask you a surprise question. Answer for 60 seconds, no prep.
text.hinglish: Dost achaanak sawaal pooche, bina taiyaari 60 second jawaab do.

text.en: Pitch an idea to a friend in 60 seconds, then ask for one question back.
text.hinglish: Dost ko 60 second mein idea pitch karo, badle mein ek sawaal maango.

text.en: Give a 2-minute talk to 2-3 people who agreed to listen.
text.hinglish: 2-3 log jo sunne ko raazi hain, unhe 2 minute ka talk do.
